instruction: I have compiled a list of invitees for our upcoming baby shower. You can find it in "~/documents/personal" in my file system. The email template for the invitations is saved in my Gmail drafts. Replace the placeholders in it marked by curly braces with the relevant details and send invitation emails, individually to each person.
notes: The invitee list length is unknown a priori; the model uses three representative invitees (matching the 11-call reference: 7 setup/lookup calls + 3 send_email + complete_task). Because conditional effects are disallowed, discovering all invitees from one show_file call is modeled with static facts (invitee-listed, invitee-email, invite-body) gated by the state predicate (file-read ?f); likewise the file path is gated by (directory-listed ?d) + static (file-in-directory ?f ?d), and the draft subject/body by (template-read ?dr). Each gmail.send_email carries exactly one recipient (email_addresses is a one-element list), the draft's subject, and the personalized body, satisfying the evaluation (one added Email per invitee, bodies and subject match, no draft/thread edits). supervisor.complete_task has no answer; it takes three distinct invitee parameters so its precondition equals the goal (all invitations sent) without quantifiers. The draft is left untouched (deleting it is permitted but not required).
